title: 临江仙（滚滚长江东逝水）
titleEn: Immortal by the River: “On and On the Yangtze Flows East”
author: 杨慎
intro: The song that opens Romance of the Three Kingdoms: the Yangtze rolls east and washes away every hero, while an old fisherman and woodcutter laugh about it all over a jug of wine. Many Chinese know it as the theme song of the 1994 TV series.
analysis: 上阕从滚滚东流的长江写起：江水一去不回，就像历史上的英雄一个个被浪花“淘”走，谁对谁错、谁成谁败，一转头就都空了。只有青山还在，夕阳还一次次变红——人事变化，自然不变，这是强烈的对比。下阕出现两个白发老人：一个打鱼的，一个砍柴的。他们在江边看惯了秋月春风，见面就喝一壶便宜的浊酒，把古往今来的大事都当作聊天的笑话。前面写英雄，后面写普通人；前面写历史的沉重，后面写看透以后的轻松。这首词本来是杨慎《廿一史弹词》里的一段，清代毛宗岗把它放在《三国演义》的开头，从此家喻户晓。1994年电视剧《三国演义》用它做主题曲，杨洪基的歌声让很多人一听就能跟着唱。
analysisEn:
The first half begins with the Yangtze rolling east. Water that flows away never returns, and in the same way the waves have “washed away” the heroes of history one after another. Who was right and who was wrong, who won and who lost — turn your head and it is all gone. Only the green hills are still there, and the sunset still turns red, again and again. That contrast — human affairs change, nature does not — is the heart of the poem.

The second half brings in two white-haired old men, a fisherman and a woodcutter, sitting on a sandbank. They have watched so many autumn moons and spring breezes that nothing surprises them. When they meet, they share a jug of cheap, cloudy wine and turn the great events of the past into small talk and laughter. So the poem moves from heroes to ordinary people, and from the weight of history to the calm of someone who has seen through it.

The lyric was first part of Yang Shen’s long ballad on Chinese history. In the Qing dynasty the editor Mao Zonggang put it at the very start of Romance of the Three Kingdoms, and it became famous. The 1994 TV series used it as its theme song, sung by Yang Hongji, so many people can sing it today.
background: Yang Shen (1488–1559) came first in the national palace examination of 1511, but in 1524 he angered the Jiajing Emperor and was exiled to Yunnan for the rest of his life. This lyric opens one section of his long historical ballad 廿一史弹词; it was later placed at the start of Mao Zonggang’s edition of Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
pronunciation: 几度 jǐ dù；白发 bái fà（不读 fā）；渔樵 yú qiáo；江渚 jiāng zhǔ；浊酒 zhuó jiǔ；都付 dōu fù；多少 duō shǎo。
version: 采用通行本（《三国演义》卷首词，与电视剧歌词一致）。原为杨慎《廿一史弹词》第三段《说秦汉》的开场词，清毛宗岗本《三国演义》移作卷首。“是非成败转头空”个别本子作“是非成败转眼空”，网站不用。

lines.py: gǔn gǔn cháng jiāng dōng shì shuǐ
lines.lit: Rolling, rolling, the Long River — water passing east;
lines.en: On and on, the Yangtze flows away to the east,

lines.py: làng huā táo jìn yīng xióng
lines.lit: the waves have washed away all the heroes.
lines.en: its waves have washed away every hero.

lines.py: shì fēi chéng bài zhuǎn tóu kōng
lines.lit: Right and wrong, success and failure — turn your head, and they are empty.
lines.en: Right or wrong, won or lost — look back, and nothing is left.

lines.lit: The green hills are still there, as before;
lines.en: The green hills stand as they always stood;

lines.lit: how many times has the setting sun turned red?
lines.en: how many sunsets have reddened over them?

lines.py: bái fà yú qiáo jiāng zhǔ shàng
lines.lit: White-haired fisherman and woodcutter, on a sandbank in the river,
lines.en: On a sandbank, an old fisherman and an old woodcutter, hair gone white,

lines.py: guàn kàn qiū yuè chūn fēng
lines.lit: are used to watching autumn moons and spring winds.
lines.en: have watched autumn moons and spring winds come and go.

lines.py: yī hú zhuó jiǔ xǐ xiāng féng
lines.lit: A jug of cloudy wine — happy to meet each other.
lines.en: A jug of rough wine, and they are glad to meet.

lines.lit: Past and present, so many affairs —
lines.en: All that has happened, then and now,

lines.lit: all handed over to laughing talk.
lines.en: becomes something to laugh about over wine.

words.en: to pass away; to flow away
words.note: 现代汉语“逝世”“消逝”，多指人去世或时间过去。

words.en: to wash away (as sand is washed in water)
words.note: 现代汉语“淘米”“淘金”；“淘汰”也是从这里来的。
现代汉语仍用，如“分清是非”；也指闲话，如“搬弄是非”。

words.en: to turn one's head — in an instant
words.note: 这里比喻时间极短；现代汉语多说“转眼”“一转眼”。
现代汉语书面语仍常用，口语说“还是”“仍然”。
度：次。现代汉语说“几次”“多少次”。
古诗里常用来代表隐居的普通人；现代汉语不单用。
古语词，现代汉语不常用，地名里还有（如“鼋头渚”）。
现代汉语说“习惯”“看惯了”。

words.en: cloudy, unfiltered wine — cheap home-made wine
words.note: 浊：不清。现代汉语“浑浊”“污浊”。
现代汉语仍用，如“传为笑谈”。

imagery.name: 长江
imagery.zh: 长江滚滚东流、永不回头，象征时间和历史一去不返，把英雄都冲走了。
imagery.en: The endlessly flowing Yangtze is time itself: it never turns back, and it carries every hero away.

imagery.name: 山
imagery.zh: 青山“依旧在”，和转眼成空的人间成败形成对比，代表永恒不变的自然。
imagery.en: The green hills that “are still there” stand against the fleeting human struggle — nature lasts, fame does not.

imagery.name: 夕阳
imagery.zh: 夕阳一次次变红，写出岁月的循环；落日也带着英雄迟暮、繁华落尽的感觉。
imagery.en: Sunset after sunset marks the passing years, and a setting sun hints at the end of glory.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 一壶浊酒是普通人的快乐，喝着酒把历史当笑谈，表现看透世事的从容。
imagery.en: A jug of cheap wine is an ordinary pleasure; drinking it while laughing at history shows a calm, unbothered wisdom.
